title: The Wood of Unfinished Roads
intro: Once upon a time, Maya and Dev followed a road that refused to end. Behind them, the lanterns of a great stone library guttered at three in the morning. Ahead, the trees leaned close to listen. For this wood remembers every word friends ever said to each other, and tonight it has come to collect.

incantations.storm: the car is making the noise

encounters.name: The Rusted Iron Steed
lines: The Steed paws the road and lowers its rusted head. It means to sweep your feet away!
Gears grind as it rears up tall. Duck, or be flattened!
It coughs a bolt of hot exhaust. Send it back where it came from!
Clank, clatter, rattle. That noise again, and forty miles from anything.
Its engine light blinks red, red, red, like a cross little eye.
encounters.artPrompt: A rusted iron horse built from a battered old hatchback, steam hissing from its joints and one headlight glaring, galloping down a moonlit forest road, whimsical ink-and-watercolor picture-book illustration, warm lantern light, no text

boss.name: The Night Librarian
lines: Shhh. The library is closing, little ones, and you have not even started.
Overdue! Overdue! Her shelves come sweeping low across the floor!
She hurls a tome heavy with every essay you never wrote!
Her hourglass turns over. It is always three in the morning here.
Maya, Dev, your library cards have expired. Forever.
